_comment: Portfolio demo by 1MR LLC. Not a real financial services firm. These loan officers are fictional. Photos are inline SVG data URIs rather than image files, so the whole lookup is one request and the repo carries no binary assets. Deliberately no NMLS IDs: inventing licence numbers for a fictional mortgage company is the one detail that could make a demo look like a real regulated entity.
_schema: slug -> { first_name, full_name, title, photo, focus }
